articles.summary: Zions Capital Markets, a subsidiary of Zions Bancorporation, N.A. (Nasdaq: ZION), has appointed Vince Toye as Managing Director, Head of Agency Multifamily Lending, following the close of its acquisition of the agency lending platform of Basis Multifamily Finance I, LLC. He assumed the role effective August 31 and is focusing on building the agency business and its service capabilities within the Real Estate Capital Markets division. "Vince is a fantastic match with our vision to expand Zions Capital Markets' capabilities and deliver exceptional services in the commercial real estate market," said Michael MacDonald, Head of Zions Capital Markets. "His leadership and expertise, combined with our new agency lending capabilities, position us to deliver comprehensive capital solutions tailored to our clients' needs." articles.summary: Harris Simmons, Chairman and CEO of Zions Bancorporation, N.A. (NASDAQ: ZION), will present at the Barclays Global Financial Services Conference, Tuesday, September 15 at 12:00 pm Eastern. An audio webcast of the session may be accessed on the Zions Bancorporation website, zionsbancorporation.com . The webcast will also be archived and available on the website. Zions Bancorporation, N.A. is one of the nation's premier financial services companies with approximately $89 billion of total assets at December 31, 2025, and annual net revenue of $3.4 billion in 2025. Zions operates under local management teams and distinct brands in 11 western states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Idaho, Nevada, New Mexico, Oregon, Texas, Utah, Washington, and Wyoming. The Bank is a consistent recipient of national and state-wide customer survey awards in small- and middle-market banking, as well as a leader in public finance advisory services and Small Business Administration lending.
